timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.80 today, down 24 cents from a month ago but up $1.12 from a year ago, according to AAA. Springfield averages $3.66. Cheaper than October, still pricey.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, Nov. 13. Time to make those last sits count.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, Nov. 14, and runs through Nov. 24. Set the alarm now, hunters.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season opens Friday, Nov. 27, and runs through Nov. 29. A perfect weekend for passing down the tradition.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, Nov. 11, one week from today. Time to find a veteran to thank.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, Nov. 26, in 22 days. Start clearing space in the freezer.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Shania Twain released Come On Over in 1997, still the best-selling country album ever by a woman in the US. Still going strong after all these years.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: The Beach Boys hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 with "Kokomo" in 1988, their first in over two decades. Time for a mental vacation.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: The animated Cat in the Hat movie has Bill Hader voicing the Cat, who is sent to cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian in their new town. Hats off to family movie night.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Fishing restrictions are lifted through Feb. 1, 2027, at Willmore Park's North Lake in St. Louis under a Missouri Department of Conservation fish salvage order. Free for all, so grab the pole.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Wisconsin angler Austin Schiefer borrowed a friend's lure on Green Bay and immediately caught a record smallmouth bass. Always borrow your buddy's best bait.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Dollar General's CEO says even $100,000 earners are hunting for bargains, and a shelf full of low prices can still cost more per ounce. Do the math before the cart.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Mortgage rates eased again Tuesday, giving buyers modest relief from rates above 7%. Slowly heading the right direction.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: A Reddit meal prepper says a case of Ball wide mouth jars from Target cost $14 and works as single-serve meal prep containers. Mason jars, the original lunchbox.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: A Skinnytaste slow cooker turkey breast recipe makes its own gravy, handy for a Thanksgiving with a smaller crowd. Gravy without the drama.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: The Kitchn's sheet pan pork chops take only an hour. One pan, one hour, dinner's done.
